prompt: Populate an inhabited landmark contested by two factions. Explain what they do while the party is gone. Labeled fixture.
expected_output: Factions have goals, fears, methods, resources, tells, offers, responses, rosters, and location moves; creatures waiting in rooms with no goals fail.

assertions.text: Provides a faction sheet for each active faction and a meaningful between-visit update
Gives inhabitants movement, objectives, and responses to bargaining, aid, deception, attack, or neglect
Uses progression states or a clock with visible changes
